BiliLocal bundles an unmodified FFmpeg executable as a separate command-line tool.
Version: 8.0.1-full_build-www.gyan.dev (Windows x64, static build)
Build provider: https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/
FFmpeg project: https://ffmpeg.org/
FFmpeg source revision: https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/commit/894da5ca7d
License and build configuration: see LICENSE and README.txt in this directory.
SHA256 (ffmpeg.exe): 74DB6C184A03DBA2BDFE23E1A1F41CF5A8385BC1DE6A7A1B26DB1DC541ABEF93

The executable is copied into the application's tools directory on build/publish.
No FFmpeg installation or PATH configuration is required on the target computer.
